mapper.select: SELECT si.id, si.chapter_id, si.item_title, si.item_intro, si.item_type, si.content_url, si.duration, si.is_required, si.completion_rule, si.quiz_json, si.sort_no, si.create_time, si.update_time, si.deleted, si.file_name, si.file_size, si.file_ext, si.completion_threshold FROM study_item si INNER JOIN course_chapter cc ON cc.id = si.chapter_id WHERE cc.course_id = #{courseId} AND cc.deleted = 0 AND si.deleted = 0 ORDER BY si.chapter_id ASC, si.sort_no ASC, si.id ASC

SELECT si.id, si.chapter_id, si.item_title, si.item_intro, si.item_type, si.content_url, si.duration, si.is_required, si.completion_rule, si.quiz_json, si.sort_no, si.create_time, si.update_time, si.deleted, si.file_name, si.file_size, si.file_ext, si.completion_threshold FROM study_item si INNER JOIN course_chapter cc ON cc.id = si.chapter_id WHERE si.id = #{id} AND cc.course_id = #{courseId} AND si.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1

SELECT si.id, si.chapter_id, cc.course_id, si.item_title, si.item_intro, si.item_type, si.content_url, si.duration, si.is_required, si.completion_rule, si.quiz_json, si.sort_no, si.create_time, si.update_time, si.deleted, si.file_name, si.file_size, si.file_ext, si.completion_threshold FROM study_item si INNER JOIN course_chapter cc ON cc.id = si.chapter_id AND cc.deleted = 0 INNER JOIN course c ON c.id = cc.course_id AND c.deleted = 0 AND c.status = 'PUBLISHED' INNER JOIN sys_user learner ON learner.user_id = #{userId} AND learner.del_flag = '0' AND learner.user_status IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE') AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sys_user_role iur JOIN sys_role ir ON ir.role_id = iur.role_id WHERE iur.user_id = learner.user_id AND ir.role_key IN ('PRE_TRAINEE', 'FORMAL_TRAINEE')) INNER JOIN dept_position learner_scope ON learner_scope.dept_id = learner.dept_id AND learner_scope.position_id = learner.position_id AND learner_scope.status = 1 AND learner_scope.position_id = c.position_id WHERE si.id = #{itemId} AND si.deleted = 0 LIMIT 1
